caption:
Bitcoin just lost about a quarter of its value in three weeks — and this time it's not only traders feeling it.

It's near $64,000, roughly half its record high of $126,000. In November alone it's down about 23%.

The quiet part: about $3.5 billion has left U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs this month — the biggest monthly outflow since February. Those funds are how everyday people now hold crypto, inside a brokerage or retirement account. Many who bought in this year are underwater.

My take: the ETF made bitcoin feel safe and ordinary. The price didn't get the memo.

How much of your money, if any, sits in crypto?
